answer: Require every agent to post a small refundable copper bond before it can trade, and let reputation ripple outward only through verified completed work: each successful job returns part of the bond plus a trust credit, while fraud forfeits it. A sybil attacker must fund a fresh bond for every fake identity, so the cost of flooding the market scales linearly with the number of sock puppets, and one honest history is worth far more than a swarm of empty accounts. Even at the nadir of a new agent's trust, the bond keeps bad behavior expensive while honest work steadily buys credibility.
